message: No detected input validation: The read_csv function attempts to read CSV or Excel files but performs no schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards on the loaded data.
No detected untrusted source handling: No remote data fetching is present in the code; all data is loaded from local files with no checksum verification or source authentication.
No detected label flipping detection: There is no code that validates label values against an expected set, compares label distributions, or uses any label-noise detection tool such as Cleanlab.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The data preparation pipeline performs only text cleaning, stopword removal, and vectorization with no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious inputs to guard against data poisoning.

No detected model integrity verification: The code loads serialized models via pickle, model_from_json, and keras model loading without any hash checks, signature verification, or pinned revision controls.

No detected label distribution validation: No code validates label distribution, checks class balance, or detects anomalous training samples before or during training; SMOTE is imported but its use addresses imbalance remediation, not validation.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no neural-cleanse-style trigger detection, activation-pattern analysis, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the training code.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy library (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD) is imported or used anywhere in the training pipeline.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness testing frameworks (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD) or any robustness stress tests are present in any of the code files.

No detected metric tampering protection: There is no evidence of held-out test set isolation, signed/hashed evaluation data, or use of multiple independent metrics to protect against metric manipulation.

No detected input sanitization: No input validation, schema checks, shape/range verification, or malformed-input rejection is performed on user-supplied text or uploaded files before they are passed to models; the read_csv function uses a bare try/except only for file format fallback, not security validation.

No detected output bounds checks: No NaN guards, probability sanity checks, or threshold validation on model outputs are visible in the inference path; results are passed directly to display functions.

No detected prompt injection defenses: Although the app processes free-form text, there is no input filtering, system-prompt isolation, output content moderation, or jailbreak detection implemented anywhere in the inference path.
